social.text: Hello all! I'm trying to put together a sound lib for people to use for there games and so on, and I'm doing it on itch.io. It's to make some money for me to get stuff that I want and or need as I don't have a job, but also want to use it for myself and at the same time have fun while making a little something. I was messing around with a little tool from Japan known as beam2002 created in 2006, as that's but a little of the tools blind people can use to do sound design. I found the software while looking around on the old music software Facebook groups, and as the software had mostly everything accessible I got together to using it. I initially was using it to make instruments for my music software of choice OpenMPT, but found that with a little work you could make more than just instruments with it. The project started out as vbasicsfx and then I just had gone with the name Sata, mostly because I didn't have anything to come up with lol. social.text: Off-centre composition 🎬 Placing your subject away from the middle of the frame adds visual interest. The empty side becomes negative space, and it can say a lot: where a character is looking, where they’re heading, or how isolated they feel. Leave space in the direction they face (lead room) and the frame feels natural. Cut it short on purpose and it feels tense. # Cinematography # Filmmaking # Composition # RuleOfThirds # NegativeSpace
